Team and Acme —

We have a tight two-day window to lock Q4 recognized revenue for the deals in the runway. Please treat this as the operational flight deck: small, clear asks, owners assigned. Attached is the Q4_rollup_template.xlsx — populate only the yellow fields by EOD tomorrow unless noted.

High-level asks (owners):
- Sales stage hygiene (Ben): verify stage = "Commit" only when PO or signed SOW received. If prospect is "Verbal" move to Commit-Pending and note expected signature date.
- Forecast numbers (David): confirm ACV/ARR lines and GAAP recognition flags; flag multi-year POs that need finance review.
- Account hygiene (Marissa): confirm expansion vs new logo, update renewal date in HubSpot.
- Escalations (Laura): any pricing or legal redlines that would delay DocuSign, escalate to me and Laura immediately.

External: Sarah, can you confirm procurement timeline for the PO? If you expect formal PO before 11/21 EOD please send to procurement@redwood.com and cc me so we can mark the deal as "Submitted PO".

Quick timeline:
- 11/19 EOD: initial template returns (yellow fields)
- 11/20 14:00 PT: sales owners stand-up (Ben leads) — quick triage of any gaps
- 11/21 11:00 PT: finance lock (David) — final inputs required for revenue recognition plan

Attachments: Q4_rollup_template.xlsx

Thanks — small, surgical updates only. I will compile into a single rollup and push to the dashboard.
